children: THE DEAL: Tech entrepreneur Parker Conrad is the buyer of a $43 million estate on Martha's Vineyard that just set a Massachusetts sales record, according to people familiar with the deal.

THE BUYER: Conrad is co-founder and CEO of Rippling, an AI-driven workforce-management platform based in San Francisco that was valued at $16.8 billion after a 2025 funding round. Conrad couldn't be reached for comment.
Mark Jenkins and Bonnie Pierce of Wallace & Co. Sotheby's International Realty, who represented Conrad, declined to comment.

THE SELLER: Boston tech entrepreneur and investor Michael Bronner assembled the roughly 31.5-acre Edgartown site, then renovated the compound before listing it for $49 million. Bronner couldn't be reached for comment. Listing agents Maggie Gold Seelig of MGS Group Real Estate and Brian Dougherty of Corcoran Property Advisors declined to comment.

THE SPECS: The property, in the exclusive enclave of Herring Creek Farm, has a roughly 6,500-square-foot main house, guesthouse and several cottages. The prior Massachusetts record was set in 2023, when Barstool Sports founder Dave Portnoy paid $42 million for a waterfront Nantucket compound.
